scientific_role: pre-outcome representation feasibility only; not ecological selector validation

refinement_centers.selection_rule: retain exactly ceil(0.025 * source_ready_candidate_count) highest-ranked candidates from the already-frozen full coarse evidence order

fine_geometry.projection_source: PR 234 pre-result geometry freeze; frozen before complete-coverage seed counts were opened
fine_geometry.window_radius_source: the already-frozen 5-km Cirsium local-frame sensitivity scale and PR 234 pre-result fine-frame geometry
fine_geometry.cell_inclusion_rule: global 100-m cell center lies within <=5000 m Euclidean distance of at least one selected coarse center after projection

source_indeterminate_lane.reason: source-indeterminate candidates have no ecological order and must not be converted into negative or ranked evidence

feasibility_endpoints.primary: unique unioned 100-m fine-cell count per unit
secondary: raw seed-to-cell membership count before union
union area km2 from unique cell count * 0.01
SHA-256 of sorted packed global grid cell IDs

interpretation.if_geometry_is_large: do not tune fraction, radius or spacing after seeing the count; close or redesign the representation prospectively
interpretation.if_geometry_is_tractable: geometry feasibility only; fine ecological source attachment and structural ranking still require separate frozen execution before any field outcome

forbidden: do not tune 0.025 after seeing cell counts
do not tune 5 km after seeing cell counts
do not tune 100 m after seeing cell counts
do not add max_cells or a local-window center cap
do not use field outcomes, private exact sites, P02 results, roads, access or budget
do not fine-expand SOURCE_INDETERMINATE_RETAIN candidates in this test
do not call fine cells occupied sites or field recommendations
